title: 1.4 Children and Babies
unit_outcome: Understand and produce simple sentences about people, family members, and actions.
goal: Meet the youngest members of one family and tell one person from more than one.
grammar_function: A + singular family member; plural family words; He is a / They are + group; The + person + is/are + action.
prerequisite: Lessons 1.1-1.3: a, the, he, they, is, are, sleeping, and running.
speaking_outcome: Name a family, a baby, babies, a child, and children, and say what the baby and the children are doing.
